📲 | Lamine on IG:
🚨 Hansi Flick's press-conference ahead of tomorrow's league match against Real Betis, follow live on our page.

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Raphinha's return? If you ask him, he’d say he’s ready. But we want to take things step by step. He’s making good progress, but we have a lot of matches and need to manage his recovery carefully. The same goes for Frenkie. The good news is they're BOTH AVAILABLE.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Frenkie de Jong? He’s a TOP player. I’m happy to have him back. He gives us another option, and he’s READY to play some minutes.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Real Betis have won all their home games and are doing well in the Champions League. We’re facing a team with fantastic players, especially in attack. Tomorrow, we’ll have to defend very well.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on resting Lamine Yamal: “It’s not so easy to answer. He’s Lamine, he’s a special player. The most important thing for him is that he enjoys playing football, and right now, that’s the case. I don’t want to interrupt that, but I know we have to manage his minutes.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Frenkie playing as a centre-back: “It’s not something we’ve trained extensively. He’s very focused and convinced that he can show how good he is. He’s a top player. We also have a lot of quality on the bench, and everyone must give 100%.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Alejandro Balde: “It’s not easy for him, but he’s training very well. We have Xavi and João, and they’re both performing at a very high level. Alejandro is doing his job, and I’m happy with what I have.” #fcblive
